cases.case_label: Alu insertion near exon-intron boundary of CPLANE1 causing exon skipping
cases.mechanism_detail: An Alu insertion close to an exon-intron boundary of CPLANE1, in trans with c.8633-4_8633-3del, was found only by long-read sequencing; transcript analysis showed it causes exon skipping, with reduced total CPLANE1 mRNA in patient fibroblasts.
cases.quote: Transcript analysis showed that each variant independently resulted in exon skipping, and quantitative expression studies revealed reduced total CPLANE1 mRNA levels in patient-derived fibroblasts.
